P_0x00121B: Pilot of the <Elemental> Jaohm; former Olympic swimming gold medalist. Taciturn, stubborn, inflexible, but warm once he opens up.
P_0x001325: First heir to the throne of the Holy Kingdom of Langran. He lacked the magical power an heir requires but overcame it through effort. A man of deep justice and duty.
P_0x001463: VA princess of Langran who failed the mana test and holds no succession right. Friendly despite her rank, she treats Masaki's group as friends. A confessed mecha fanatic, she designs <Elemental> units and computers.
P_0x001625: Princess of Langran and Xenia's twin sister. Unlike Xenia she has high mana as a seer and stands second in the succession. Gentle at best, slightly absent at worst, with an elegant, otherworldly air. Her subtly broken grammar leaves all around her deflated.
P_0x001808: UThird heir of Langran; illegitimate son of former King Alzarl. Apathetic and listless.
P_0x0018CE: A young genius with ten doctorates. Cool, calm, and utterly self-assured, he hates being used and never forgives those who do. Under Dr. Bian Zoldark of the <EOTI Organization> he designed the Granzon and its special gear and test-pilots it himself. His identity and past are unknown.
